name: asia_oc_MU_ls
thesis: Asia memory leaders close hours before the US open; the open only partly absorbs it, so go with the Asia move open-to-close

name: asia_oc_MU_long
thesis: Same, long-only: buy MU at the open only when Asia memory was up

name: asia_oc_MU_thr
thesis: Trade only when the Asia move is large (|z|>1): costs matter, conviction filter

name: asia_oc_sk_MU
thesis: SK hynix alone: the pure-play DRAM peer, long/short MU

name: asia_oc_basket
thesis: Slower-reacting US storage names (WDC, STX) may absorb Asia news less at the open than MU

name: asia_unabsorbed_MU
thesis: Trade the gap shortfall: Asia-implied gap minus MU's actual gap (what the open failed to price)

name: gap_continue_MU
thesis: Large gaps in MU continue intraday (gap-and-go)

name: gap_fade_MU
thesis: Large gaps in MU overreact and fade intraday

name: gap_basket_continue
thesis: Memory basket gap (MU, WDC, STX) continues in each name: theme-wide gap is information

name: laggard_gap
thesis: WDC/STX gap less than MU's: the laggards catch up intraday toward the leader

name: overnight_hold_MU
thesis: Own the overnight only: MU earns its premium close->open (institutional flow)

name: intraday_only_MU
thesis: Own the intraday only (mirror): premium open->close

name: peer_rev_5d
thesis: 5-day reversal within the memory theme: laggards vs leaders vs the theme average, daily hold

name: peer_mom_21d
thesis: 21-day relative momentum within the theme (leader keeps leading)

name: MU_trend100
thesis: Hold MU only above its 100-day average: cyclicals trend

name: theme_breadth
thesis: Hold MU when most of the theme (SKhynix, Samsung, Nanya, Winbond, MU, WDC, STX) is above its 50d average

name: MU_volscaled
thesis: Hold MU scaled to 40% target vol: it's a 48%-vol cyclical

name: MU_buyhold
thesis: Buy and hold MU (benchmark, not a candidate)

name: theme_buyhold
thesis: Equal-weight buy-and-hold MU/WDC/STX (benchmark)

name: night_x_trend_MU
thesis: Own MU overnight only while its trend is up

name: night_x_breadth_MU
thesis: Own MU overnight only while the memory theme is healthy

name: night_always_day_breadth_MU
thesis: Overnight leg always on; add the intraday leg only when the theme is healthy

name: night_basket
thesis: Does the overnight effect generalize to WDC and STX? (equal-weight, ungated)

name: night_x_trend_basket
thesis: Basket overnight, each name gated by its own trend

name: night_always_day_breadth_basket
thesis: Basket: overnight always, intraday only in healthy-theme regimes

name: night_always_day_breadth_basket_vt
thesis: Same as above, scaled to 35% target vol (cap 1.5x)

name: full_x_trend_x_breadth_basket
thesis: Hold full-time only when own trend up AND theme healthy, else nothing

name: us_full_x_trend_x_breadth
thesis: Hold each name full-time only when its own trend is up AND US memory/semis breadth is healthy

name: us_night_always_day_breadth
thesis: Overnight leg always on; intraday leg only when US breadth is healthy

name: us_full_x_trend_x_smh
thesis: Own trend up AND the semiconductor sector (SMH) in an uptrend; simpler single external gate

name: us_full_x_trend_x_breadth_vt
thesis: First variant scaled to 35% target vol, cap 1.5x
